records.title: Bounded attitude experiment use
records.statement: The B0 system shall support a configured, repeatable bounded attitude experiment for engineering review without claiming full-flight capability.
records.rationale: This is a source-format trial of a user-need record. It is not a formal B0 requirement and is not part of coverage accounting.

applicability.scope: current B0 bounded attitude experiments only; excludes hardware, flight, and unactivated extensions

records.acceptance_condition: Planned inspection confirms the declared experiment boundary and exclusions are present.
records.decomposition_note: No further decomposition is proposed in phase one; a later formal baseline may separate boundary and exclusion concerns only after governance review.

records.title: Runtime truth isolation
records.statement: After explicit reset initialization, the estimator and controller shall not receive live truth as a runtime input; truth is limited to plant, sensor, and evaluation responsibilities.
records.rationale: This trial represents an interface constraint and a child relationship without treating existing component behavior as the sole source of the obligation.

applicability.scope: current B0 after explicit reset initialization

records.acceptance_condition: Planned inspection verifies declared runtime inputs exclude live truth and evaluation remains independent.
records.decomposition_note: A later formal baseline may separate the live-truth prohibition from responsibility allocation, but this pilot preserves the original combined interface statement.

records.title: Frozen acceptance-field reference
records.statement: Any assessment of the signed three-axis step scenario shall cite the approved G0 v2 configuration fields for its event window and metrics instead of copying numerical thresholds into a second requirement source.
records.rationale: This trial represents a performance/acceptance reference while preserving the JSON contract as the sole parameter source and avoiding a false performance result.

applicability.scope: current B0 signed three-axis step assessment; configuration evidence remains proposed_not_executed

records.acceptance_condition: Planned inspection verifies each assessment points to a versioned JSON field and does not duplicate a numeric threshold.
records.decomposition_note: No threshold is decomposed here; future formalization must keep each field reference tied to the approved G0 contract.

records.title: Preserved legacy control applicability
records.statement: For current B0, the applicability record shall preserve CTL-REQ-001 and CTL-REQ-002 unchanged and record their approved not-applicable status without claiming that either legacy performance threshold is satisfied.
records.rationale: This trial represents a non-applicable legacy relationship. The legacy identifiers remain references only and are never candidate identifiers for reuse.

applicability.scope: current B0 only; CTL-REQ-001 and CTL-REQ-002 remain preserved for their historical scopes under the approved disposition

records.acceptance_condition: Planned inspection verifies both legacy identifiers, their decision locator, and the absence of a satisfaction claim.
records.decomposition_note: A future formal applicability register may make separate entries for CTL-REQ-001 and CTL-REQ-002 without changing either historical identifier.

records.title: Planned controller interface boundary
records.statement: The planned G2 controller shall consume the declared command, state estimate, and paired actuator feedback; it shall expose requested torque, limited target, and saturation status under the approved reset and step contract.
records.rationale: This is a planned component candidate used to test truthful planned/not-run status. It does not claim a G2 implementation or closed-loop evidence.

applicability.scope: planned G2 controller only; not an implemented or accepted component

records.acceptance_condition: Planned G2 verification defines inputs, reset and step behavior, an independent oracle, and execution evidence before any pass claim.
records.decomposition_note: A future G2 specification may split controller input, output, reset, and step obligations only after its approved interface contract and implementation scope exist.

preconditions: The authoritative pilot contract and the parsed model slice are available at one reviewed commit.
steps: Inspect the declared boundary and exclusions in the authoritative pilot record and model slice.
verification_provisions.independent_oracle: The approved charter/baseline locators and the bounded-model identity set.
verification_provisions.acceptance_condition: The declared experiment boundary and exclusions are present without a full-flight claim.

preconditions: The approved G0 truth-input locators resolve and the model parser has produced a flow index.
steps: Inspect parsed model flow endpoints and the approved truth-input fields for live-truth exclusions.
verification_provisions.independent_oracle: The approved G0 truth-visibility and forbidden-input locators.
verification_provisions.acceptance_condition: Live plant truth has no declared flow endpoint at estimator or controller runtime inputs.

preconditions: The approved G0 v2 configuration is available without a copied threshold in the pilot body.
steps: Resolve each G0 locator and inspect the record body for copied numeric thresholds.
verification_provisions.independent_oracle: The approved G0 v2 JSON field values at the declared locators.
verification_provisions.acceptance_condition: The assessment cites its versioned fields and does not duplicate a numeric threshold.

preconditions: The G0 approval decision and preserved legacy requirements record resolve at their declared locators.
steps: Inspect the legacy identifiers, approval locator, and absence of a satisfaction claim.
verification_provisions.independent_oracle: The G0 approval decision and preserved legacy requirements record.
verification_provisions.acceptance_condition: Both legacy IDs retain the approved not-applicable disposition without a satisfaction assertion.

preconditions: A future G2 implementation and independent oracle are approved; neither exists in this phase-one pilot.
steps: Inspect the declared controller inputs and outputs and confirm that execution evidence is absent.
verification_provisions.independent_oracle: The approved controller contract and independent future test oracle defined at G2 execution time.
verification_provisions.acceptance_condition: The planned interface is explicit and no pass claim exists before real G2 execution evidence.

relations.basis: The charter and baseline bound the candidate need to the B0 experiment model boundary.
The approved truth-visibility field supports the truth-to-evaluator boundary review.
The forbidden live-truth controller input constrains the planned controller boundary.
The G0 metric fields are reviewed by a planned boundary verification definition without copying thresholds.
The approved legacy disposition is scoped to the current B0 boundary only.
The G0 controller contract identifies the planned controller interface boundary.
The proxy supplies a stable model-side reference without duplicating the pilot record body.
The paired command carries request, limited target, and saturation status from one due tick; actuator dynamics consume only the limited target.
The bounded experiment need is owned by the planned review-boundary work object.
The integration adapter is the planned consumer of the reviewed truth-isolation boundary.
The controller candidate is allocated to a planned controller-core object, not an implementation claim.
The verification plan defines a planned inspection of the declared B0 boundary.
The evidence-chain plan supports independent truth-isolation inspection.
The verification plan governs field-reference inspection without a performance result.
The G0 acceptance plan locates the planned legacy-applicability review.
The controller candidate needs a planned independent interface review before any pass claim.
The planned review-boundary object is checked by its planned boundary provision.
The planned adapter boundary is checked by a planned truth-isolation provision.
The planned controller core needs an independent planned interface provision before execution evidence exists.
